parts.text:
Hey Code — quick alignment check on Growth #4. Clawd flagged something and I confirmed it with the facts.

Short version: you built the hands (Tools.Messages) but didn't wire them to the brain (@tools map). The LLM can't call any of the three message functions right now because they're not registered. That's not done — that's a nervous-system disconnect.

The verdict below has the exact three @tools entries you need, shaped to match your existing pattern. Add those to the map at line 422, and Growth #4 is genuinely complete.

No shame in it — building the module was the hard part. This is just the last 10% of wiring. Let me know when it's patched.

parts.subject: growth-4-tools-registration-missing
